meta.requirement: Explore Sal Terrae (30%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Stone Heart
start.text:
''The salt flats stretch white and endless under a pale sky. Far ahead, the silhouette of a Statue of Seven rises from the crust, half-buried in mineral dust. You are still a good distance away when the ground ahead begins to move.''

''Two Geo Slimes roll in slow, patient circles around the statue's base. Behind them, an Anemo Samachurl beats its staff against the salt, chanting in a language that makes the wind tug at your sleeves even though the air should be still.''

''They have not seen you yet. But they are between you and the stone.''

Clear_them_out.text:
''You step forward. The crust crunches loud enough to carry. The Geo Slimes stop rolling. The Samachurl's chant breaks off mid-syllable, mask turning toward you, staff raised.''

''The nearest slime pulses once, a dull golden thud through the flats. The second shifts to flank you. The Samachurl clicks its teeth and calls up a gust that scatters salt into your eyes.''

''There is no path to the statue except through them.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Defeat the Geo Slimes and Anemo Samachurl blocking the Sal Terrae Statue

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Fight the Slimes and Samachurl. Defeat 2 [[Geo Slime]]s and 1 [[Anemo Samachurl]]

Fight_the_Slimes_and_Samachurl.text:
''The last slime crumbles to pale dust. The Samachurl lets out one long, rattling exhale and collapses into the salt. The wind drops. For a moment the flats are perfectly still.''

''Then, from the lee of the statue, a young woman in layered Liyue opera dress steps into view. She has a folding fan in one hand and a pot of tea gone cold on a stool behind her. She does not look surprised. She looks relieved.''

Yun Jin: ''fan snapping shut'' Well fought. I was beginning to wonder whether I would have to handle that myself, and this dress is not made for slime-chasing.

''She gestures toward the weathered stone figure with her fan. Its face is turned toward Liyue like it is still listening for a name no one has spoken in years.''

Yun Jin: Have you ever stood this close to a Statue of Seven before?

Once_far_to_the_west.text:
Yun Jin: ''a small, knowing smile'' Then you have felt one Archon's blessing and not the other. This statue was raised for Morax, the Geo Archon. Contracts, endurance, the weight of stone made gentle. ''She taps the fan against her palm.'' Travelers who pray here can carry Geo in their strikes, the same way wind answers those who know how to ask at Windrise.

''Her gaze lifts to the statue's closed hands.''

Yun Jin: But this one sleeps. The salt has eaten its voice. I have been trying to wake it properly, not with force. With courtesy.

choices.label: How do you wake a statue?

How_do_you_wake_a_statue.text:
Yun Jin: Geo is not wind. Wind moves you. Geo holds you. ''She steps closer, voice dropping into the rhythm of explanation.'' When Geo meets fire, ice, water, or lightning in battle, the elements crystallize. Stone rises up around what remains, a shield born from the clash. That is Crystallize. Defense from conflict itself.

''She inclines her head toward the statue.''

Yun Jin: Morax's blessing works the same way in spirit. You do not demand it. You present yourself. You offer something the earth here recognizes, and the stone remembers you.

''A beat. She studies your face.''

Yun Jin: I think you are ready to try. Will you pray with me?

I_will_try.text:
''You stand before the statue with Yun Jin at your side. The salt crust crunches softly underfoot. She sets her fan aside and folds her hands with practiced grace. You mirror her.''

''Silence holds. Then, around Yun Jin's boots, a faint golden light threads up from the flats, steady and warm. The dust near her hem lifts and settles again, as if the ground itself has bowed.''

Yun Jin: ''eyes still closed'' There. Morax still hears me.

''She opens one eye and looks at you. Nothing has changed on your side. The statue remains cold, gray, and utterly still.''

Yun Jin: ''quiet pause'' ...Hm. That is unusual.

Nothing_happened_for_me.text:
''You feel no warmth, no weight lifting from your shoulders, no answering pulse in the stone. Yun Jin walks a slow circle around the base, fan trailing at her side, studying the statue's worn features with the focus of a director blocking a scene.''

Yun Jin: The blessing is real. I have carried Geo from this place before. ''She stops.'' Which means we skipped a step, not that the stone has gone deaf.

choices.label: I must have done it wrong

What_step.text:
Yun Jin: The offering. ''She presses her fingertips together, chagrined in a way that is almost theatrical.'' I was so pleased to find another traveler out here that I forgot the first rule of every good introduction. You do not arrive empty-handed before an Archon.

''She lifts two fingers.''

Yun Jin: Sal Terrae knows Noctilucous Jade. The flats hide it beneath the crust, green stone that drinks lamplight. Bring twenty pieces. And five Tails of Boreas, the trophy of the wolf who keeps Wolvendom. Even Morax respected that king of beasts.

''She gestures to the statue's base.''

Yun Jin: Lay them here. Pray again. The stone will answer.

Twenty_jade_and_five_tails.text:
Yun Jin: Twenty Noctilucous Jade, five Tails of Boreas. ''She recites it like a line she intends to remember.'' Mine the flats for the jade. The tails you will have to earn from Andrius, if you have not already.

''She picks up her fan and snaps it open once, a soft crack in the dry air.''

Yun Jin: I will be here when you return. Some performances only work if the audience arrives at the right moment. This is one of them.

I_will_gather_what_you_need.text:
''Yun Jin settles back onto her stool with the calm of someone who has already seen the ending of the play. The statue looms above you both, patient and mute, waiting for a gift the earth will recognize.''

Yun Jin: ''without looking up'' Do not rush the wolf for his tails, traveler. The stone has waited centuries. It can wait a little longer for you.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Gather 20 Noctilucous Jade and 5 Tails of Boreas for the Sal Terrae Statue

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Pray at the Statue

gather_20_noc.text:
''You return to the Statue of Seven at Sal Terrae. The afternoon light turns the salt to dull gold. Yun Jin is exactly where you left her, fan resting on her knee, tea still untouched.''

Yun Jin: ''rising'' You are back. Did yoNot yet. Still gatherinu bring what the stone asked for?

choices.label: Yes. The jade and the tails

Not_yet__Still_gathering.text:
Yun Jin: ''sits again, unhurried'' Then the stage is not set. ''She fans herself once.'' Mine the flats for Noctilucous Jade. Face Andrius for the tails. I am in no rush to leave. This statue has been good company.

Yun Jin: Return when your hands are full.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Gather 20 Noctilucous Jade and 5 Tails of Boreas for the Sal Terrae Statue

Stone_Heart__Blessed_by_the_Geo_Archon.title: Blessed by the Geo Archon
Stone_Heart__Blessed_by_the_Geo_Archon.text:
Yun Jin: ''soft intake of breath'' Good. ''She steps back, giving you the center.'' This is your scene.

''You kneel at the statue's base and arrange the twenty pieces of Noctilucous Jade in a ring of green light against the white salt. The five Tails of Boreas you lay at the center, pale fur stark against stone. For a moment, nothing moves.''

Yun Jin: ''whispering'' Introduce yourself. Tell Morax why the earth should know your name.

''You bow your head and pray. The hum begins low, deep in the bedrock, rising through the crust into your bones. The jade glows. Golden dust spirals up from the offering and sinks into your chest, heavy and sure, like a hand steadying your shoulder.''

''When you open your eyes, the world feels anchored. The salt flats no longer seem endless. They seem held.''

Yun Jin: ''barely above a breath'' There it is.

''The glow fades, but the weight stays, warm rather than burdensome.''

Yun Jin: ''smile breaking through'' Morax has answered. Geo is yours to carry now. The statue will serve you as it serves all who keep their contracts with the earth.
Stone_Heart__Blessed_by_the_Geo_Archon.unlocks: [[Statue of the Seven#Geo|Statue of the Seven (Geo)]]
